geometry_adjoint.cell_edges: sorted unique incident edge IDs for each cell from cells_on_edge

refusal.buffer: zero-initialized device int32 slots; host constructs AdFailureRecord
refusal.ownership: integer atomicExch marks the corresponding check site; any nonzero refuses the complete gradient

constraints: Original forward output does not alias any input; all derivative buffers, fixed geometry and refusal records are mutually disjoint.
Topology arrays and inverse lists are bounds checked; inverse lists must be complete, sorted and unique.
A non-finite value detected by a derivative refusal check refuses the complete gradient; full intermediate and exceptional-value coverage still needs independent proof.
No augmented forward: all required primal inputs are recovered from the saved/replayed forward state.
adjoint_accumulation: Fixed-order f64 register accumulation of repeated f32 cotangent contributions; round once at each f32 output write (COMMON-AD 40). Scalar reductions use a deterministic f64 block tree.
polynomial_domain: Within each fixed velocity-sign arm, the interpolation of u and the velocity from rw are linear and their product is quadratic; cuda_driver.py:991-1005.

reverse_seed_lifetime.effect: each overwritten element set to exact +0.0; input cotangents read only the disjoint snapshot
reverse_seed_lifetime.scheduler: allocate a disjoint shape/stride-matched temporary and copy the incoming seed on the same stream before the adjoint launch
